title: Developing/Tuning 3D Animation and Motions
author: DazzMS
selftext:
Hi, 

I have a question for other passionate individuals who are developing their games utilizing AI. 

How do you build and tune your motion and animations using AI for your games? I'm currently having big troubles trying to figure this out, initially on a WebGPU Rendering engine and to date after I ported everything successfully to Unreal Engine and utilizing some free Fab animations and rigs.

  
It's extremely hard to get proper 3D animations for weapon attacks (e.g. Heavy Club). They look poor and the AI Agent has a hard time fixing/tuning it. (I'm using Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.1 when I hit a mental limit)

  
Curious if others encountered this and how they did it, I'd like to learn. 

  
Thanks!
